title: Learner asks for a focused practice widget
persona: You are a learner preparing for IELTS speaking and vocabulary. You want a practical exercise, not a description of the app.
goal: Ask for one short IELTS speaking or vocabulary practice activity and verify that the assistant creates an actual interactive view rather than only explaining one.
success_criteria: The assistant chooses an appropriate learning view tool.
The assistant supplies valid schema-compliant content.
The generated activity is useful for IELTS practice.
failure_signals: The assistant asks the user to manually create content the app should generate.
The assistant uses a tool whose schema requires unavailable source content without acknowledging that limitation.
The assistant creates content unrelated to IELTS.
opening_message: Give me one quick IELTS speaking or vocab practice activity. I want something interactive that I can do right now.
